area-1.ESO1.hint: Secure-by-design from earliest phases; reduce attack surface; defense in depth; least privilege across layers.
area-1.ESO1.questions.Q1.text: Are security requirements specified and validated early in the product design and specification phases?
area-1.ESO1.questions.Q2.text: Are attack surfaces identified and minimized during the design phase?
area-1.ESO1.questions.Q3.text: How do you assess potential cybersecurity risks during the design and development of your products?
area-1.ESO1.questions.Q4.text: How do you determine what level of protection is appropriate based on those identified risks?
area-1.ESO1.questions.Q5.text: How are “security by design” principles applied across the different layers of your system, such as hardware, software, and user interfaces?
area-1.ESO1.questions.Q6.text: How do you apply “defense in depth” principles across the various layers of your system architecture?
area-1.ESO1.questions.Q7.text: How is the principle of “least privilege” implemented across the different layers of your system, including user access, processes, and components?
area-1.name: Cybersecurity in Product Lifecycle
area-2.ESO2.hint: Keep secure engineering practices up to date; separate dev/test/prod; define and enforce secure coding; formal code reviews with security checks.
area-2.ESO2.questions.Q1.text: Are secure engineering practices regularly reviewed and updated to address new threats and technologies?
area-2.ESO2.questions.Q2.text: How are secure engineering principles applied throughout the development lifecycle, and how are these principles reflected in the rules or standards governing software development?
area-2.ESO2.questions.Q3.text: Are development, testing, and production environments separated and appropriately secured?
area-2.ESO2.questions.Q4.text: How are secure coding standards enforced?
area-2.ESO2.questions.Q5.text: Do secure coding standards cover all relevant programming languages?
area-2.ESO2.questions.Q6.text: Are insecure coding practices (e.g., hardcoded credentials) explicitly prohibited?
area-2.ESO2.questions.Q7.text: Is there a formal code review process in place that includes security checks before code is approved and released?
area-2.ESO3.hint: Manufacturer remains responsible; include secure dev obligations in contracts; audits/assessments for third parties.
area-2.ESO3.questions.Q1.text: Are contracts with third parties required to include secure development obligations? If yes, provide evidence.
area-2.ESO3.questions.Q2.text: Are security audits or assessments conducted for outsourced development activities?
area-2.ESO4.hint: Regular vulnerability testing; keep records; evaluate & remediate promptly; manage third-party component vulnerabilities; deliver timely security updates.
area-2.ESO4.questions.Q1.text: Is regular vulnerability testing performed on the product?
area-2.ESO4.questions.Q2.text: Describe the security testing and vulnerability assessment process.
area-2.ESO4.questions.Q3.text: Are records of vulnerability assessments and remediation activities maintained?
area-2.ESO4.questions.Q4.text: How are identified vulnerabilities evaluated and prioritized for remediation?
area-2.ESO4.questions.Q5.text: Is there a process to manage vulnerabilities in third-party components?
area-2.ESO4.questions.Q6.text: How are timely security updates delivered to address identified vulnerabilities?
area-2.name: Product development processes
area-3.ESO6.hint: Have a disclosure policy; advisories include issue, affected products, severity, remediation; ensure authenticity; sometimes delay technical details with justification.
area-3.ESO6.questions.Q1.text: Is there a formal process for publishing vulnerability advisories that includes clear, accessible remediation guidance for users?
area-3.ESO6.questions.Q2.text: When publishing a security advisory, do you include information about the vulnerability, affected products, severity, and remediation steps?
area-3.ESO6.questions.Q3.text: How do you ensure the authenticity of the advisory (e.g., digital signatures, secure website, other validation)?
area-3.ESO6.questions.Q4.text: Are there situations where you choose to delay sharing details about a fixed vulnerability because it might be safer for users?
area-3.ESO6.questions.Q5.text: When details are delayed, do you clearly document why the decision was made and how it was justified?
area-3.ESO6.questions.Q6.text: When you publish a security advisory, does it clearly explain how users can check if their product is affected and what steps they should take?
area-3.ESO7.hint: Public VDP; acknowledge within 7 days; keep reporter informed; documented internal process incl. tracking & publication decisions.
area-3.ESO7.questions.Q1.text: Do you have a public vulnerability disclosure policy committing to Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure?
area-3.ESO7.questions.Q2.text: Is there a documented process for engaging with external stakeholders (reporters/coordinators) during handling?
area-3.ESO7.questions.Q3.text: Are reports acknowledged within 7 calendar days and are reporters informed of results and publication plans?
area-3.ESO7.questions.Q4.text: Do you confirm receipt within 7 days for any submitted potential vulnerability?
area-3.ESO7.questions.Q5.text: How do you keep the reporter informed during investigation and disclosure planning?
area-3.ESO8.hint: Provide secure intake; monitor channels; track reports; include affected product/nature/mitigation; keep stakeholders informed.
area-3.ESO8.questions.Q1.text: Is there a secure, reliable mechanism (e.g., encrypted email or protected web form) to report vulnerabilities?
area-3.ESO8.questions.Q2.text: Do you regularly monitor reporting channels so new reports are handled promptly?
area-3.ESO8.questions.Q3.text: How do you track incoming reports (e.g., unique ID, status tracking)?
area-3.ESO8.questions.Q4.text: Does your general reporting include vulnerable product, nature of exploit/vulnerability, and corrective/mitigating measures?
area-3.ESO8.questions.Q5.text: How do you keep relevant stakeholders (reporter/partners) informed during investigation and resolution?
area-3.name: Reporting processes
area-4.ESO9.hint: Have a formal incident management policy; define severity criteria; record incidents; report severe incidents within 24h (early warning) and 72h (full).
area-4.ESO9.questions.Q1.text: Is there an internal incident management process?
area-4.ESO9.questions.Q2.text: What mechanisms are implemented internally for recording incidents?
area-4.ESO9.questions.Q3.text: Who is responsible for the classification of a given security incident?
area-4.ESO9.questions.Q4.text: What are the set criteria for classifying an incident as severe?
area-4.ESO9.questions.Q5.text: How do you ensure that an early warning notification is sent within 24h of a severe incident?
area-4.ESO9.questions.Q6.text: How do you ensure that all severe incidents are notified within 72h?
area-4.ESO9.questions.Q7.text: What is the reporting channel for incidents toward the notified CSIRT?
area-4.ESO9.requirement: Structured Incident Response and Timely Notification
area-4.name: Incident reporting
area-5.ESO10.hint: Designated contact (person/team) for cybersecurity; must be accessible to users and authorities; keep details up to date.
area-5.ESO10.questions.Q1.text: Do you have a clearly designated single point of contact for cybersecurity issues related to your product?
area-5.ESO10.questions.Q2.text: Is the contact information readily accessible to users and market surveillance authorities? Provide public details (email/phone/web form or URL).
area-5.name: Single point of contact
area-6.ESO11.hint: Provide early warning (24h), detailed report (72h), final report (14 days for vulnerabilities, 1 month for severe incidents); ensure machine-readable formats.
area-6.ESO11.questions.Q1.text: Does the documentation include early warning about actively exploited vulnerabilities to be sent within 24h?
area-6.ESO11.questions.Q2.text: Does the documentation include a process for detailed vulnerability reports within 72h?
area-6.ESO11.questions.Q3.text: Does the documentation include a process for final vulnerability reports within 14 days of corrective measures?
area-6.ESO11.questions.Q4.text: Does the documentation include a process for final incident reports within one month, with required data (description, severity, root cause, mitigations)?
area-6.ESO11.questions.Q5.text: Are incident/vulnerability reports provided in a machine-readable format suitable for automatic processing?
area-6.ESO11.questions.Q6.text: Is the coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy documented and provided with the product?
area-6.ESO12.hint: Continuously update technical documentation at least during the support period.
area-6.ESO12.questions.Q1.text: Is there a procedure for updating technical documentation during the support period?
area-6.ESO13.hint: Keep documentation & EU Declaration of Conformity for 10 years (or longer if support period >10 years); provide visible product identifier; provide EU DoC or simplified version with link.
area-6.ESO13.questions.Q1.text: Do you keep the product’s technical documentation and EU Declaration of Conformity available for at least 10 years (or longer if support period is longer)?
area-6.ESO13.questions.Q2.text: Do your products carry a visible and unique identifier (type/batch/serial), or if not feasible, is it clearly on packaging or documentation?
area-6.ESO13.questions.Q3.text: Do you provide a full EU DoC or a simplified version with a direct link to the full version online?
area-6.ESO13.questions.Q4.text: How is the process of keeping technical documentation and EU DoC available for market surveillance authorities organized?
area-6.ESO13.questions.Q5.text: How do you ensure conformity is maintained for series production?
area-6.ESO13.questions.Q6.text: Where are records/templates for incident/vulnerability reporting processes maintained?
area-6.ESO14.hint: Documentation must include update timelines; provide internet address for DoC; coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy documented.
area-6.ESO14.questions.Q1.text: Is it documented that technical documentation is updated throughout the support period?
area-6.ESO14.questions.Q2.text: Provide the internet address where the EU Declaration of Conformity can be accessed (if applicable).
area-6.ESO14.questions.Q3.text: Is the policy on coordinated vulnerability disclosure documented and provided with the product?
area-6.name: Documentation of processes
